[[File:FieldSurgeonRing.png|thumb|right|250px|A Field Surgeon Ring]]
A '''Field Surgeon Ring''' was a [[Ring/Legends|ring]] worn by [[Medic/Legends|medics]]. One of these rings was given on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to a medic by [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Nillika]] of the [[Mos Eisley Medical Center]] for helping treat beings that were injured in a firefight between between [[Valarian/Legends|Lady Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|guards]] and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|thugs]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:CitC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|Caught in the Crossfire|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Field Surgeon Ring was an item in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CitC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Field Surgeon Ring was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was a reward for the quest "[[W:c:swg:Caught in the Crossfire|Caught in the Crossfire]]" for players of the [[W:c:swg:Medic|Medic profession]]. The ring slightly enhanced the player's constitution when worn.<ref name="SWG:CitC" />
